text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Why, if it isn't my dear Shakur! I hear it's
your
birthday!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But I haven't said anything yet?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I already know you've brought along
some
dumbass contraption for me to
test.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've told you plenty of times already, but
I don't
have any interest in being your
guinea pig.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How regrettable. And after I came all
this way to
sincerely wish my friend a
happy birthday.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The hell? I know you don't have a single
sincere
bone in your body.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If that is your stance, then so be
it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But at the very least, understand that I
prepared
a wonderful present for you
from the bottom of
my pure, sincere
heart!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Behold, my latest concoction! I call it,
"Scroll
Even in Your Dreams!" One sip,
and you'll be able
to scroll on your
computer while aslee—
